SERVER1/1281RS/ 73
Pending projects of various Ministries
†*241. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of STATISTICS AND
PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
several projects under various Ministries
which were sanctioned 25 years back but
their construction has not started as yet;
(b) if so, the number of such projects;
(c) the names of the Ministries to which
these projects belong togetherwith the
number of such projects under each
Ministry; and
(d) the total amount spent on each of
these projects upto March, 2004?
 Poor functioning of Rohru telephone
exchange in Shimla
†*242. SHRI SURESH BHARDWAJ:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that all the telephone sub-exchanges
under Rohru telephone exchange in Shimla
are not functioning properly;
(b) whether it is a fact that the earthing
has not being done properly in telephone
sub-exchange at Bhatwari as a result of
which cards either become defective again
and again or these get burnt and it takes
2-3 months to get them repaired;
(c) if so, by when, Government would
improve its condition so as to make it
function properly; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor
togetherwith the number of telephones
which are lying out of order for the past six
months?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

SERVER1\1281RS RAW TEST\1281RS 74
 Broadband policy
*243. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to announce a fresh policy to push
broadband and internet penetration with
focus to provide faster connectivity at
lower prices;
(b) if so, whether Government have also
decided to have a revamp of the telecom
policy; and
(c) if so, to what extent this new policy
would attract new investment, create job
opportunities and provide access to new
and improved services?
 Joint venture for making satellites
*244. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ISRO has
entered into an agreement with Boeing
company to make satellites under joint
ventures;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what will be the financial
implications for ISRO;
(d) whether any profits are expected
by ISRO; and
(e) to what extent ISRO would be able
to technically contribute to this joint
venture?
 Number of unemployed persons
*245. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of unemployed persons
from 2000-01 to 2003-04, State-wise;
(b) what steps are being taken to make
available the employment opportunities
and reduce the rate of unemployment
growth;
(c) whether it is a fact that the
Agriculture and Animal Husbandry field
has a potential to generate many crore jobs
at local village level, if proper programmes
and policies are adopted; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Inclusion of new industries in list of
ARIs
†*246. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have got any
survey or research conducted for including
certain new industries in the existing agro
and rural industries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of the industries which
have recently been included therein;
(d) the number of industries covered
under agro and rural industries till March,
2004 alongwith details thereof; and
(e) the value of annual production done
by these industries?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

SERVER1\1281RS RAW TEST\1281RS 75
 Increase in number of pilgrims for
Kailash Mansarovar
†*247. SHRIMATI SA VITA
SHARDA: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have sent any
proposal to Chinese Government to
increase the number of pilgrims visiting
Kailash Mansarovar;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Chinese Government
in this regard?
 Children covered under the NCLP
*248. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of children covered under
the National Child Labour Project since its
inception, State-wise;
(b) budget allocated for eliminating the
child labour under NC

Server2\session_July_2004\841Rs
Promoting rural industries
†901. SHRI ISAM SINGH: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
promote rural industries under any special
scheme;
(b) if so, whether Government would
make any changes in education policy in
order to make the said scheme successful;
and
(c) if so, the format thereof?
Jobs for youth in villages
902. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRIMATI JAMANA
DEVI BARUPAL:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to put an end to the migration of people
from rural to urban areas and decided to
provide jobs to youth in villages including
those in the far-flung areas and put an end
to Inspector Raj;
(b) if so, the concrete proposals worked
out in this regard; and
(c) by what time they are likely to be
implemented?
Labourers in agro and rural
industries
†903. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:  Will  the  Minister  of  AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have come to
know through any survey about the
number of labourers that have been working
in the existing agro and rural industries;
(b) if so, total number of labourers
engaged in this sector;
(c) whether there is possibility for more
employment generation in this sector; and
(d) if so, the possibilities and the plan
proposed by Government for realising the
same?

Expansion of rural industries
†904. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of  AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
those agro and rural industries in the States
which still have sufficient possibility for
development and expansion at local level;
(b) if so, the names of those ten
industries which are likely to be developed
to the maximum alongwith names of the
respective States;
(c) the average annual value of
production generated by these industries
in each State; and
(d) the percentage of increase likely to
be achieved after their expansion?
Demand of Khadi goods by Railway
†905. SHRI PYARE LAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRO AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Railways has proposed to
procure Khadi goods from Khadi and Village
Industries Commission as per the
declaration of Minister of Railways to use
khadi in trains;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Khadi and Village Industries
Commission is capable to meet this big
order;
(d) if so, the extent to which such a big
purchase would affect Khadi and Village
Industries Commission in respect of
employment generation etc. and the details
thereof; and
(e) if not, the steps being taken by
Khadi and Village Industries Commission
to get this order from Railways?
Export of Coir products
906. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is an increasing global
demand for natural fibres;
(b) if so, the details of the coir products
exported for the last three years and the
foreign exchange earned for the last three
years, year-wise, State-wise and category-
wise;
(c) whether the minimum export price
for coir products is scrapped during the
regime of the last Government;
(d) whether action would be taken to
restore the minimum export price for coir
products;
(e) if so, details thereof;
(f) if not, reasons therefor; and
(g) the total employees associated with
coir industry, as on date, State-wise?
Coverage of mobile telephone services
in Uttaranchal
†907. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether he is aware of the fact that
coverage of the mobile telephone service is
very limited and their standard is very poor
in most of the districts of Uttaranchal State;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
instal new towers to improve the standard
of mobile telephone services and to expand
their coverage in the State; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
